data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves increased (net strengthening) on prior years by approximately GBP 24.7m (gross) at 31 December 2016. The syndicate reports adverse development concentrated in Professional Lines and Marine Liability, with large individual losses during the year (Jubilee/Tullow Ghana, Space X, Vermillion/Samir oil refinery and Pemex) contributing to increased claims activity. These adverse movements were partially offset by favourable developments in other classes and reserve strengthening on Warranty & Indemnity matters in earlier years. The gross prior-year strengthening (derived from the gross claims development table) equates to c.12.1% of opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 102.4m (2015: GBP 68.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 2.8m (2015: improvement of GBP 9.0m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Marine Liability with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

In 2016 the Syndicate was unaffected by catastrophe claims, however there has been an increase in large claims across multiple lines in the year most notably on the Energy, Marine and Reinsurance classes, from the Jubilee (Tullow Ghana), Space X, Vermillion (Samir oil refinery) and Pemex claims.
Additionally, there has been reserve strengthening on Warranty & Indemnity losses reported in previous years in the Professional Lines account on the 2014 & Prior years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year gross movement obtained by comparing diagonals in the gross claims development table (page 38) and summing movements for underwriting years 2011-2014 (excluded 2015 and 2016). The managing agent narrative reports a NET deterioration of GBP 2.8m (net of reinsurance) - the gross triangle indicates a gross prior-year strengthening of c. GBP 24.745m, implying significant reinsurer share movements offsetting gross adverse development. Gross figures sourced from triangle (units: GBP '000) and balance sheet. No gross 'movement in prior year's provision' explicit line-item was provided; therefore triangle was used as primary source for gross PYD. RITC activity: the report notes the 2014 year of account was reinsured to close into 2015; this has been considered but the gross triangle was used regardless. All monetary figures converted from the report's GBP '000 to millions for this output.
